capabilities: Reset heading letter-spacing to normal so ligatures render in H1-H6
Leave body-text styling under theme control
Generate D2_LigaFix derivative fonts from NAVER D2Coding with a bundled Python converter
Verify derivative font structure and hashes before export
extras: The plugin ships no font file; ligatures only appear after the user builds and installs the D2_LigaFix derivative font (Python 3.10+ needed for the converter, which verifies SHA-256 and Git blob hashes against upstream). The README is written in Korean. Marked as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Chromium disables OpenType ligatures on elements with non-zero letter-spacing, so themed headings fail to render ligatures that work in body text.

requires.name: D2_LigaFix font installed system-wide (built from NAVER D2Coding via the bundled converter)
Python 3.10+ (only to run the font converter)

summary: CSS-only plugin that restores D2Coding programming ligatures (->, =>, !=, <=, >=) in headings by resetting the theme's letter-spacing.
